At first, the gong was cold and indifferent, saying, “The agreement will expire in three years. I hope you will leave quietly.”
Ji Ruan turned on his cochlear implant and looked tired, asking, “Sorry, I didn’t hear clearly. Could you say it again?”
Gong: “…Or maybe you should just rest.”
Later, the white moonlight revealed the truth angrily: “Do you think he married you because he loves you? You just look like me. He only loves me!”

77170.synopsis:

“Sect Leader, a newborn was left in front of our gate!”

Early the next morning, Jiang Yu’s beloved, Chen Xinxin, posted a Moment: “Thank you for being by my side when I was most helpless and desperate.”
The picture was of Jiang Yu’s side profile, eyes closed in sleep.
At that moment, I finally gave up on ten years of waiting and erased him completely from my heart.

123250.synopsis:
Nina is a Guide.
The paired Guide of Eugene Taylor, an S-Class Esper and the greatest icon of the Third Allied Government.
She’s never guided him.
She’s never even checked their compatibility rate.
In fact, she’s never met him, nor has she ever officially registered as a Guide.
She’s spent all twenty years of her life confined indoors, knowing only the world beyond the TV screen. She’s the incompetent outcast of an underground criminal group ignored by the government…
And yet, Nina is his paired Guide. Because if she isn’t—
“…Ah, found you.”
…Huh?
“I’ve missed you, Nina.”
There’s no way that Eugene Taylor just showed up in her room… right?
***
“That, ugh…”
A deep furrow appeared between Eugene Taylor’s sculpted brows.
He glanced at the device on the man’s wrist.
“E-eleven?”
Even if Nina knew nothing else, she knew that an 11% stability rate was extremely dangerous. If it dropped to a single digit, the Esper would go berserk. Indeed, as if to signal that danger, the device screen was flashing orange. It was all just like what she’d seen on TV.
“What should I do…? Nina, want to try guiding?”
“Huh?”
Yet, even in this precarious situation, the man was calm.
“Just try it. I think you might have a talent for it.”
“H-how…”
And Nina, firmly believing herself to be Eugene’s guide, was ready to do it.
“What if it doesn’t work?”
“…There are many ways.”
The man’s eye-smile, as he whispered reassuringly, was utterly captivating.
associated_names: 폭주 직전 에스퍼가 내 방에 나타났다

123762.synopsis:
Transmigrating into a world in chaos, I never expected to be given a wife right from the start.
Born with heterochromatic eyes? A woman marked by ill fortune!
A beauty capable of toppling nations!
Since all of you fear her and avoid her like the plague, then don’t blame me for being impolite!
With a beauty in my arms and a system by my side, who in this world can compete with me!

124274.synopsis:
“Welcome, players, to the Dimension Rift Game Express. This train will depart from the E-Level Station and head toward the D-Level Station. Please ensure your personal safety as you board in an orderly manner, and follow the riding rules.”
“The riding rules are as follows:”
“1. Do not bring non-game items onto the train. (Underwear is an exception.)”
“2. Spending is mandatory. (All train staff are unpaid volunteers.)”
“3. Do not turn on the lights after lights-out. (Unless you’re exceptionally skilled and fearless.)”
“In addition, the train encourages ambushes, brawls, hunting, and other forms of recreation—players are free to choose as they please.”
“Have a pleasant journey.”

126834.synopsis:
Xiao Fan transmigrated into a cultivation world… only to become a brainless side-villain doomed to die at the hands of the protagonist.
In the original storyline, he would’ve been toyed with, humiliated, and killed without mercy.
Fortunately, he awakened the Villain System. As long as he made the right choices, he could claim divine treasures—and survive.
To live, Xiao Fan had no choice but to strike the protagonist with overwhelming force.
······
Cold, aloof master: “My disciple’s name is Xiao Fan. I have no disciple like you.”
Protagonist’s childhood sweetheart: “Stop contacting me… I don’t want Xiao Fan to misunderstand.”
Protagonist’s little sister: “You don’t understand Brother Xiao Fan at all. He’s the kindest man in the world.”
······
Seizing fate, stealing luck, intercepting fated partners—Xiao Fan rose by snatching every opportunity meant for the protagonist.
One by one, he cut off the protagonist’s lucky encounters, treasures, and destined Dao companions.
A thousand years later, Xiao Fan stood at the peak of all realms—the ultimate mastermind, the black hand behind the curtains.
Xiao Fan; “You called yourself a Child of Destiny, yeah? Well screw that. I’m your karmic retribution.”
associated_names: 反派：绝不放过每一位气运之女！
我，天命大反派，从拿捏圣女开始

141170.synopsis:
Gu Fangzhi transmigrated into a game he used to play and became the treacherous minister who shared his exact name.
Bad news: The emperor is a tyrant.
Worse news: He transmigrated right into the middle of an impeachment session.
Even worse news: The emperor had just said he would have him dragged out and executed.
Good news: Gu Fangzhi can load and rewind saves.
Gu Fangzhi grinned.
Dog Emperor, I’ve come to bargain.jpg
On the first day Pei Xin ascended the throne, he decided to follow in his tyrant father’s footsteps.
He believed there was nothing in this world that couldn’t be solved with the words:
“Drag him out and behead him.”
And if there was—
Behead him twice.
He didn’t expect that this would be where his nightmare began.
The peach-eyed man he had just ordered to be dragged away suddenly reappeared before his eyes the next second.
“Your Majesty, you must not!”
Pei Xin: ???
Damn, sorcery?! That’s terrifying.
Determined not to provoke this wizard-like man, Pei Xin endured humiliation and suffering to keep the peace.
“Your Majesty, do not be picky with your food.”
After rejecting it three times, Pei Xin finally broke down and ate all the greens in his bowl.
“Your Majesty, you must not neglect your studies.”
After rejecting it five times, Pei Xin broke down and memorized the entire book.
“Your Majesty, you must not waste time playing.”
After rejecting it seven times, Pei Xin broke down and put away the little trinket gifted from the Western Regions.
“Your Majesty, may this minister get out of bed now?”
After the man ran away dozens of times, Pei Xin finally snapped and pinned him down hard.
“Gu Fangzhi, rewind as many times as you want, I will never give up. Do you dare defy your Emperor’s favor?”
Pairing:
Emperor (top) × Loyal Minister (bottom)
Pei Xin × Gu Fangzhi

146546.synopsis:
I was born with a silver spoon in my mouth, right in the middle of a mob family. But when I lost consciousness and woke up, I wasn’t the boss, nor the successor—I was a mere housekeeper.
To make matters worse, I was the timid, introverted extra whose role was to die in place of the female lead. At first, I just worked silently to survive, but it turns out the housekeeping life suits my aptitude better than I thought.
But then, the male leads, who used to shudder with disgust at the original owner, started sticking to me, begging me to do this and that….
I started dealing with them the way I’d play with young nephews… but strangely, they keep taking their clothes off in front of me and showing off their muscles.
Yeah. I guess since you’re the male leads of an R-19 novel, your bodies are killer. But guys. The female lead is over there? Why are you stripping in front of me? You’ll catch a cold.
A push-and-pull love story between an indifferent housekeeper and the three gangster brothers—where only the housekeeper is clueless about what’s going on.
associated_names: Reincarnated as a Housekeeper in a 19+ Gangster Romance Novel
전직 조폭 보스의 19금 소설 속 가정부 빙의기

148850.synopsis:
What happens when the Constellation has a bad internet connection?
Yoon Se-eum is a Constellation who can grant anything, from wealth to SSS-rank awakenings and miracles. But when she reconnects to Earth to support her favorite client, she discovers a fatal problem: The system is lagging.
Support items arrive seventeen hours late. Critical buffs trigger only after the battle is over. Even a simple “Like” reaches its target long after the danger has passed.
Caught in the middle of this technical nightmare is Ha Gyu-hyeok, a low-ranked D-class hunter with no other sponsors. Alone in lethal dungeons, he quietly waits for the Constellation who promised to stay by his side, unaware that her help is simply stuck in a digital queue.
Unable to watch him struggle any longer, Yoon Se-eum makes an unprecedented choice: If the system won’t cooperate, she’ll bypass it. Even at the cost of all her Karma, even if it bends the laws of causality, she descends to Earth, standing right next to him.
associated_names: D급 헌터의 성좌인데 인터넷이 안 됨
I'm a D-class hunter, but I can't access the internet.

160370.synopsis:
Bjorn Schmidt, a paladin of the Holy Principality of Rimasoth, does not believe in love.
“Unfortunately, I am in no position to promise you a future.”
Before the impregnable wall of a paladin who remained cold despite all kinds of romantic advances, countless women grew weary and fell away on their own.
All except one.
Leila Bailey.
“My feelings for you are the same as they were five years ago.”
The holy war began and ended over the course of five long years, yet even after all that time, she continued to look only at him. This time, however, Bjorn resolves to finally sever her one-sided love, but…
This is the story of a taut tug of war between a man who has never believed in love his entire life and a woman who has devoted her entire life to love.
Who, in the end, will be the victor?

178546.synopsis: It has been three years since dungeons appeared on Earth. I work in the materials research department of a general chemical manufacturer and am not blessed with a good boss. While at a construction site being built for the Olympics, I am suddenly registered as the number one ranked person in the world. This is a leisurely story (or so he hopes) about a protagonist who is given impossible powers in a realistic world and tries to live his life getting involved with the world’s trends as little as possible. Even though the setting is hard sci-fi, the main focus of the story is the protagonist’s everyday life.
associated_names: Ｄジェネシス　ダンジョンができて３年
